weapons.name: Rattler MG
weapons.description: Rapid-fire machine gun. Low damage per round, overheats under sustained fire.

weapons.name: Seeker Missile
weapons.description: Lock on to the car ahead, then fire. A hard turn or drift can shake it off.

weapons.name: Tripwire Mine
weapons.description: Drops behind you and arms after a moment. Punishes tailgaters.

weapons.name: Scatter Gun
weapons.description: Six-pellet shotgun. Devastating at close range, useless at a distance. Slow to cycle.

weapons.name: Oil Slick
weapons.description: Dumps a pool of oil behind you. Anyone driving through it loses grip and steering for a moment.

weapons.name: Stinger Rear Gun
weapons.description: Rear-facing turret. Hold to hose down whoever is sitting on your bumper. 30-round drum.

weapons.name: EMP Pulse
weapons.description: Short-range pulse. Jams nearby rivals' weapons and boost, and fries incoming missiles and mines.

weapons.name: Hornet SMG
weapons.description: Buzzing submachine gun. Very fast, very light rounds, short reach. Spray and keep spraying.

weapons.name: Longbow Cannon
weapons.description: Slow, heavy single shots with pinpoint accuracy at long range. Every miss hurts.

weapons.name: Buzzsaw Twin
weapons.description: Twin-barrel machine gun: two rounds a shot in a loose pattern. Forgiving aim, mid range.

weapons.name: Swarm Rockets
weapons.description: Six mini-rockets with a quick lock. Each hits softly and turns lazily, but they come in waves.

weapons.name: Thumper Mine
weapons.description: A big, slow-arming mine with a wide blast. Two per load: place them where the pack bunches up.

weapons.name: Frost Patch
weapons.description: Sprays a sheet of ice behind you. Smaller than oil, but whoever hits it slides for longer.

weapons.name: Shockwave
weapons.description: A tighter, harder pulse: real damage to everyone close, but only a brief jam.

weapons.name: Tailgunner
weapons.description: Rear-facing shotgun. Five pellets a blast into whoever is glued to your bumper. Six shells.

weapons.name: Sky Mortar
weapons.description: Lobs a shell that homes in on the race leader and lands with a huge blast. Back-markers only.

weapons.name: Hornet Swarm
weapons.description: Four mini-missiles, each already locked on a different racer ahead of you.

weapons.name: Afterburner
weapons.description: Three seconds of huge speed with a shield up. Anyone you ram gets wrecked.

weapons.name: Mega Shockwave
weapons.description: A giant pulse: jams every rival within 35 m and fries their missiles and mines.

weapons.name: Mega Mine
weapons.description: A huge mine with a wide trigger, dropped behind you. Leaders love it.

weapons.name: Missile Ward
weapons.description: Destroys every missile and mortar aimed at you, then shields you for three seconds.
